payment.title: Payment suspense
payment.description: Money arrived but cannot move forward: late callback, amount mismatch, or closed order. Handle one by one; refunds go back the way they came, dismissals require a reason.
payment.refund.title: Refund this suspense entry?
payment.refund.confirm: {amount} will be refunded to the buyer via the original channel. If the channel does not accept it, the entry stays open and can be retried.
payment.dismiss.title: Dismiss this suspense entry
payment.dismiss.placeholder: Reason (required): confirm this money does not need to go back to the buyer
